nodes.summary: The exponential is bounded by the real exponential of the norm.
nodes.title: Norm of the exponential is bounded by the exponential of the norm

nodes.summary: The one-step Trotter estimate: `exp x * exp y` differs from `exp (x + y)` by at most a quadratic expression in `‖x‖` and `‖y‖`.
nodes.title: One-step Trotter estimate

nodes.summary: The Taylor remainder of `exp` at order one.
nodes.title: First-order Taylor remainder bound for the exponential

nodes.summary: Powers differ at most linearly in the difference of the bases. The `1` in the maximum is needed: without it the bound fails when the norms are `< 1`.
nodes.title: Linear bound on differences of powers for the Trotter formula

nodes.summary: Telescoping estimate for powers in a normed ring with `‖1‖ = 1`: `‖a ^ m - b ^ m‖ ≤ m ‖a - b‖ max(‖a‖, ‖b‖) ^ (m - 1)`.
nodes.title: Telescoping estimate for differences of powers in a normed ring

nodes.summary: If `Y M → X` and `m M / M → t`, then `(1 + M⁻¹ • Y M) ^ m M → exp (t • X)` as `M → ∞`.
nodes.title: Compound-interest limit in a Banach algebra

nodes.summary: The Trotter product formula for bounded elements of a complete normed algebra: `(exp (a / n) * exp (b / n)) ^ n → exp (a + b)` in norm.
nodes.title: Trotter product formula

nodes.summary: If `a` and `b` commute, the Trotter approximants are exactly `exp (a + b)` for every positive `n`.
nodes.title: Trotter product formula for commuting elements
